parts.name: Two-Tone Wingtips
parts.desc: 1950s two-tone spectator wingtip brogue shoes, black and white leather, with laces. The sheet has three shoes: the top two are side views (toe pointing right); the bottom one is the same shoe seen from the FRONT, toe pointing straight at the viewer, small and narrow like the input's bottom piece - not a side view and not a back view.
